name: Victor's Home (2F)
description: The second floor of the building, which is Victor's private residence. A comfortable living space with a kitchenette, a sofa, a dining table, and a bedroom area separated by a partition. Much nicer than the office downstairs. Empty whiskey bottles are visible in the kitchen trash.

items.name: Expensive Wine Collection
items.description: A small wine rack with several bottles of imported wine. Some bottles are suspiciously high-end for a small-town boss's salary.

items.name: Business Planner
items.description: A leather-bound business planner on the dining table with Victor's schedule and notes. Some pages have angry scribbles and crossed-out entries.

items.name: Whiskey Bottles
items.description: A collection of expensive single-malt whiskey bottles on the kitchen counter. Three are empty, two are half-full. The brands are premium imports costing $80-120 each.

items.name: Divorce Papers
items.description: A folder stuffed behind books on the shelf. Contains finalized divorce papers and several bitter handwritten letters never sent.

items.name: Phone with Call History
items.description: Victor's personal phone left on the nightstand, screen unlocked.

conditions.description: A well-furnished private residence, but with signs of lonely drinking habits. The air smells faintly of whiskey.
